name: bootloader-crimes
description: Bootstrap disposable Windows VMs configured through a web app

paragraphs: This utility allows you to configure a Windows VM using a web UI, then download a tiny disk image which contains a Linux-based stager and your configuration. If run, it will bootstrap an OS installation according to the configuration. It will deploy Windows 11 on a MBR partition with BIOS boot, which is somewhat cursed but functional and easy to use in hypervisors.
This repo contains both the frontend code for the web application, as well as the scripts that make up the bootstrap disk image.
